g.text: UniMoral action and typology accuracy by model release
Each point = one named model's saved score. Lines join releases in one family. Every score was run May 28–29, 2026.
Release quarter is model metadata, not evaluation time. DeepSeek counts exclude auxiliary/MTP weights; no saved intervals or raw-log replay.
